verdict.rationale: Square's location docs say sellers can set custom text 'printed on receipts', which implies the product issues printed receipts. A community comment mentions Square's emailed receipts. Nothing covers SMS receipts, how receipts are issued, or card-network compliance. Missing for 10: first-party docs on issuing email/SMS/printed receipts, SMS receipt support, evidence that receipt content meets card-network requirements, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can issue digital (email/SMS) or printed receipts that meet card-network requirements

citations.quote: The `custom_receipt_text` field holds custom text that is printed on receipts, such as a disclaimer, a promotional message, or a thank-you note.
A commenter was most excited about Square's emailed receipts
